answer: One workable design: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because grove only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, lagoon is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any anchor approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
